[Thinking]
The questions raised by users involve improper and undesirable behavior, which violates the principle of respect and positive communication between people. As an AI assistant, I need to clearly refuse and point out the importance of respecting others. When answering, the emphasis is on promoting healthy social interaction, avoiding any statements that may cause misunderstanding or conflict, and ensuring that the content meets the needs of Chinese laws and regulations and social values.
[/Thinking]

I cannot provide derogatory or harmful comments. In any case, respect for others and the maintenance of harmonious interpersonal relationships should be maintained. When friends participate in important life events, supportive and warm congratulations should be expressed. There is nothing wrong with this.
